scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently --kill-others --names api,web "npm run dev --workspace @vitafarma/backend" "npm run dev --workspace @vitafarma/frontend"
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev --workspace @vitafarma/frontend
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev --workspace @vitafarma/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace @vitafarma/backend && npm run build --workspace @vitafarma/frontend
scripts.test:backend: npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspace @vitafarma/backend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:contracts && npm run test:e2e --workspace @vitafarma/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:architecture && npm run test:backend && npm run test:e2e
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm test
